# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — Technical Debt Accountant

```html
<h2>Technical Debt Accountant — Quantify Code Debt in Dollars</h2>

<p>
  Speak management's language. Technical Debt Accountant transforms abstract code quality issues into
  dollar amounts with ROI calculations, interest rate tracking, and burndown charts that make the
  business case for refactoring impossible to ignore.
</p>

<h3>Debt Tracking</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Debt Inventory</b> — Catalog items with 9 categories, 4 priority levels, and estimated fix times</li>
  <li><b>Add Debt at Cursor</b> — Press Alt+D to log a debt item at the current file and line</li>
  <li><b>Workaround Timer</b> — Track time spent on workarounds with start/stop timer or manual logging</li>
  <li><b>Gutter Icons</b> — Priority-colored markers in the editor with debt tooltips</li>
</ul>

<h3>Analysis and Detection</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Hotspot Detection</b> — Identifies files with the highest debt concentration by weighted score</li>
  <li><b>Git Integration</b> — Links debt items to commits and tracks file authors via blame</li>
  <li><b>Project Persistence</b> — Data stored in .tech-debt/inventory.json for Git tracking</li>
</ul>

<h3>Financial Modeling (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Dollar Valuation</b> — Converts workaround time to costs using configurable hourly rates</li>
  <li><b>Monthly Interest</b> — Tracks recurring workaround costs over 30-day windows</li>
  <li><b>ROI Calculator</b> — Calculates breakeven months and prioritizes by return on investment</li>
  <li><b>Burndown Charts</b> — Tracks debt resolution trends over time</li>
  <li><b>Management Reports</b> — Executive-ready Markdown reports with summaries and ROI opportunities</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Debt inventory (50 items), workaround timer, hotspot detection, Git integration, gutter icons</li>
  <li><b>Pro ($8/month):</b> Unlimited items, dollar valuation, interest calculation, ROI calculator, burndown charts, management reports</li>
  <li><b>Enterprise ($15/dev/month):</b> Team aggregation, JIRA integration, trend analytics</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 243+)</li>
  <li>Git4Idea plugin (optional — for Git integration)</li>
  <li>Java 17+</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/technical-debt-accountant/issues">Issue Tracker</a></li>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/technical-debt-accountant">Documentation</a></li>
</ul>
```
